cleanName: Onslaught of the Fire Kings Structure Deck

name: Fire King High Avatar Garunix
extDescription: During the next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When you do: Destroy all other monsters on the field. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Fire King" monster from your Deck, except "Fire King High Avatar Garunix".

name: Fire King Avatar Barong
extDescription: If a face-up "Fire King" monster you control is destroyed by a card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During the next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Add 1 "Fire King" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Fire King Avatar Barong".

name: Fire King Avatar Kirin
extDescription: If a face-up "Fire King" monster you control is destroyed by a card effect (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can send 1 FIRE monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.

name: Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
extDescription: During your next Standby Phase after this card was destroyed by a card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. When you do: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

name: Manticore of Darkness
extDescription: During the End Phase of the turn this card was sent to the Graveyard: You can send to the Graveyard 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster from your hand or your side of the field; Special Summon this card from your Graveyard.

name: Goka, the Pyre of Malice
extDescription: If you control a FIRE monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When you do: Target 1 FIRE monster you control; destroy that target. During each of your Standby Phases: Special Summon 1 "Fireball Token" (Pyro-Type/FIRE/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Defense Position. You can Tribute 1 other FIRE monster; this card gains 500 ATK, until the End Phase.

name: Hazy Flame Hyppogrif
extDescription: Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 other FIRE monster; this card gains 300 ATK.

name: Laval Lancelord
extDescription: You can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. If you do, during the End Phase: Send it to the Graveyard. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 of your banished FIRE monsters; add that target to your hand.

name: Flamvell Firedog
extDescription: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with 200 or less DEF from your Deck, except "Flamvell Firedog".

name: Flamvell Poun
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can add 1 monster with 200 DEF from your Deck to your hand.

name: Neo Flamvell Sabre
extDescription: While your opponent has 4 or less cards in their Graveyard, this card gains 600 ATK. While your opponent has 8 or more cards in their Graveyard, this card loses 300 ATK.

name: Royal Firestorm Guards
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned: Target 4 Pyro-Type monsters in your Graveyard; shuffle all 4 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

name: Volcanic Rocket
extDescription: When this card is Summoned: You can add 1 "Blaze Accelerator" card from your Deck or Graveyard to your hand.

name: Volcanic Counter
extDescription: When you take battle damage while this card is in your Graveyard: Banish it from your Graveyard, then if there is a FIRE monster other than "Volcanic Counter" in your Graveyard, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the amount of battle damage you took.

name: Molten Zombie
extDescription: When this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

name: Spirit of Flames
extDescription: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE monster from your Graveyard. This card gains 300 ATK during your Battle Phase only.

name: Raging Flame Sprite
extDescription: This card can attack your opponent directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: This card gains 1000 ATK.

name: Fox Fire
extDescription: During the End Phase, if this card was destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard this turn and was face-up at the start of the Damage Step: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. This face-up card cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

name: Flame Tiger
extDescription: During your Draw Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you control no monsters, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can Special Summon this card from the Graveyard. If this card is Special Summoned with this effect, banish it when it leaves the field.

name: Little Chimera
extDescription: All FIRE monsters on the field gain 500 ATK. All WATER monsters on the field lose 400 ATK.

name: UFO Turtle
extDescription: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

name: Onslaught of the Fire Kings
extDescription: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters: Special Summon 1 FIRE Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster from your Deck. Its effects are negated and it is destroyed during the End Phase. You can only activate 1 "Onslaught of the Fire Kings" per turn.

name: Circle of the Fire Kings
extDescription: Target 1 FIRE monster you control and 1 FIRE monster in your Graveyard; destroy that monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon that other monster from your Graveyard. You can only activate 1 "Circle of the Fire Kings" per turn.

name: Rekindling
extDescription: Special Summon from your Graveyard as many FIRE monsters as possible with 200 DEF. During the End Phase, banish all monsters that were Special Summoned by this effect.

name: Blaze Accelerator
extDescription: You can target 1 monster your opponent controls; send 1 Pyro-Type monster with 500 or less ATK from your hand to the Graveyard, and if you do, destroy that target. You cannot declare an attack during the turn you activate this effect.

name: Wild Nature's Release
extDescription: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior-Type monster; it gains ATK equal to its current DEF until the End Phase. During the End Phase, destroy it.

name: Pot of Duality
extDescription: Reveal the top 3 cards of your Deck, add 1 of them to your hand, then shuffle the rest back into your Deck. You can only activate 1 "Pot of Duality" per turn. You cannot Special Summon during the turn you activate this card.

name: Hand Destruction
extDescription: Each player sends 2 cards from their hand to the Graveyard, then each player draws 2 cards.

name: Creature Swap
extDescription: Each player chooses 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

name: Burden of the Mighty
extDescription: Each face-up monster your opponent controls loses 100 ATK × its own Level.

name: Backfire
extDescription: When a FIRE monster(s) you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Flamvell Counter
extDescription: When a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Banish 1 FIRE monster with 200 DEF from your Graveyard; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

name: Phoenix Wing Wind Blast
extDescription: Discard 1 card to target 1 card your opponent controls; return that target to the top of the Deck.

name: Horn of the Phantom Beast
extDescription: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 800 ATK. When the equipped monster destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Draw 1 card.

name: Blast with Chain
extDescription: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. When this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
extDescription: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

name: Regretful Rebirth
extDescription: When a monster you control is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Target that monster; Special Summon it in face-up Defense Position, but it is destroyed during your End Phase.

name: Nightmare Wheel
extDescription: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card. During each of your Standby Phases while that monster is on the field: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

name: Call of the Haunted
extDescription: Target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in face-up Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.
